subject: design/read-to-rule-tech-design-v1
statement: tech-design-new gains one additive step: §0 is written **last**, after §1–§7 and Principles are stable, from the design's own content — each ranked call lifted from a `**Decision:**` callout and its displaced `#ALT-n`, each number from an acceptance/DINV bound, each open question from §7, every routed item anchored per DINV-1. §0 is never generated — it re-litigates nothing of `read-to-rule-v1`'s frozen ruling that §0 is authored, not folded.
